# 16 — Region maps from your own ROMs, Location explorer, Timers, Home fixes (v0.1.0, `develop`)

**Date:** 2026-11-23 · **Branch:** `develop` only (main untouched, no release) · **Version:** 0.1.0

Nothing in this pass ships, commits or downloads game artwork. ROMs, extracted images and your map marks
stay on your computer (`~/.local/share/pokemmo-companion/private/maps/…` and the database). The repository
contains only decoding code and SHA-1 hashes of decoded resources (used to recognise a verified build).

## 1. Region-map extraction (Tools › Location explorer › Region maps…)

Workflow: type or browse to a ROM file **or the folder that holds them** → *Check* (header recognition) →
*Extract* (background job) → preview in "Waiting for review" → **Accept** or **Reject**. Installed artwork is
replaced only on Accept (atomic rename with crash recovery); a failed or rejected import keeps the working map.
The ROM is memory-mapped read-only (`ACCESS_READ`), never copied, changed or uploaded. Zipped ROMs must be
unzipped first. Re-importing never touches your marks.

| Region | Source | Method (verified against the owner's files) | Output | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kanto + Sevii | FireRed `BPRE` rev 1 | GBA LZ77 4bpp tiles (0x3EF68C), 4 LZ77 30×20 text-BG tilemaps (0x3F090C/0x3F0B6C/0x3F0C7C/0x3F0D60), BGR555 palette 0x3EF34C; screen frame cropped | Kanto, Sevii 1–3, 4–5, 6–7 — 192×144 each | **Tested with the real ROM** |
| Hoenn | Emerald `BPEE` rev 0 | LZ77 8bpp affine tiles (0x59F77C), LZ77 64×64 affine map (0x5A04E0), 0x90-colour palette before the tiles; cropped to content | Hoenn 248×152 | **Tested with the real ROM** |
| Johto | HeartGold `IPKE` / SoulSilver `IPGE` (Europe files) | NitroFS `a/1/4/4`: NCGR 10, NSCR 11 (64×64, linear), NCLR 20; cropped to the map (47×20 tiles) | Johto 376×160 | **Tested with both real ROMs** |
| Sinnoh | Platinum `CPUE` (Europe file) | NitroFS `graphic/tmap_gra.narc`: top-screen map NCGR 19 / NCLR 0 / NSCR 22 + route layer 24; bottom-screen zoom map NCGR 20 / NCLR 1 / NSCR 25 + 26 (32×32 block order) | Sinnoh 216×168, Sinnoh zoom 512×512 | **Tested with the real ROM** |
| Unova | Black `IRBO` (NDSi enhanced) | Recognised; the Town Map artwork was **not located** (every NARC archive with full-screen 2-D background screens was rendered and inspected; the only Unova-shaped screen is the Battle Subway map) | — | **Not available**: unavailable state + full encounter explorer |

Not tested (no files available): FireRed rev 0, LeafGreen, Emerald other revisions, US/JP/other-language
HGSS/Platinum, White. GBA builds are searched for the same decoded resources by hash (any offset); DS builds
are decoded structurally and, if the decoded data differs, marked **unverified** so you can judge the preview.
HGSS's Kanto Pokégear map was not located (Kanto comes from FireRed). The Platinum zoom map uses the stored
palette, which looks darker than in-game (the game likely changes brightness on the bottom screen).

## 2. Location explorer (redesigned, same tool: Tools › Location explorer, popout, Quick access)
- Region tabs Kanto · Johto · Hoenn · Sinnoh · Unova (with match counts when a Pokémon/filter is active).
- Large central map: wheel / buttons / `+` `−` zoom around the pointer, drag to pan, arrow keys, `0` fit, 1:1,
  full screen; nearest-neighbour scaling, aspect ratio never changed; sub-map chips (e.g. Sevii pages, Sinnoh zoom).
- Markers / Labels / Highlights toggles; clicking a mark opens that location; transition marks switch sub-map.
- Without artwork: a clear unavailable panel (import button; Unova explanation) — never a fake map.
- Left: search, Pokémon picker (sprite, number, type badges, Summary link), type, encounter type, time of day,
  season, hordes. Right: matching locations (◉ on your map / ○ not yet) or the location detail.
- Location detail: Gen V library sprites, name/#, type badges, method, levels, horde ×3/×5, season,
  morning/day/night rarity labels exactly as the dump gives them + provenance; links to Summary, notes, guides.
- Pokémon → highlighted locations (green) and dimmed others; Pokédex › Locations has *Show in Location explorer*.
- Popout: compact (list), standard (map + list), expanded (filters + map + list).

## 3. Edit map
Select/move, + Marker, + Rectangle, + Polygon (double-click/Enter to finish). Every mark must name a real
location from your installed data (or be a transition to another sub-map). Kind (town, route, cave, special,
transition, other), label, note. Undo/redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), Delete key, unsaved work auto-kept as a draft and
offered for restore, Save/Discard, Export/Import JSON (validated: region, ids, 0..1 coordinates). Lists
"Not on the map yet" and marks whose location is missing from your data. Coordinates are normalised per
sub-map, stored in the database apart from the artwork. No coordinates are shipped or guessed: the map starts
empty and fills as you place locations. Sub-maps are those extracted from your ROM.

## 4. Tools › Timers
Named timers (h/m/s), presets 5/15/30 min/1 h, start/pause/resume/reset/duplicate/delete/rename, repeat,
per-timer sound, progress ring (bar in compact), several at once, keyboard (Space start/pause, R reset), popout
(compact/standard/expanded) and Quick access pin. Completion is detected by the backend thread, so pages can be
closed. Delivery uses the Live toast/OS-notification path (Settings › Notifications › Timers), respects Do not
disturb, and each completion is delivered once; only one window plays the synthesised chime.
Time keeping: CLOCK_BOOTTIME while running (counts through suspend, ignores wall-clock changes) + stored
wall-clock end time. **Sleep:** keeps counting, fires once on wake (late). **Quit / restart / reboot:** keeps the
end time; on the next start you see the right remaining time, or "finished while closed" with one late
notification. Repeat timers skip the periods they slept through. Not in-game spawn timers; separate from Live.

## 5. Home
- *More official updates*: only posts **published** in the last 90 days (a feed post discovered today but
  published a year ago is archive material). Archive link unchanged.
- *Official events*: only ongoing (scheduled window open) and upcoming; otherwise a one-line empty state.
- Latest update and the Events/Quick access column now end on the same line (stretch + column flex, footer
  pinned to the bottom); stacked layout under 1000 px. No fixed heights.

## 6. Tests
`tests/test_region_maps.py` (decoders, header checks, read-only, hash search, synthetic NitroFS/NARC, review/
accept/reject/rollback/crash recovery, path containment, layout validation and export round trip, API; real-ROM
tests with `POKEMMO_ROMS_DIR`), `tests/test_timers_news.py` (timer arithmetic, pause, concurrency, wall-clock change,
sleep, restarts, quiet mode, routes, single sound claim, API, news window), `tests/ui/test_ui_maps_timers.py`
(unavailable state, zoom/pan/sub-maps/regions, editing with undo/redo/drag/save/export, Pokémon highlight,
filters, popout modes, timers with two windows and one chime, Quick access, Home window + alignment).
Synthetic fixtures do not prove compatibility with other ROM builds.
